info: Version 8.39.0 rebuilds Tax & CSV export with complete history, fiat values and templates for popular tax tools, brings KNS names, KRC-20 token discovery, UTXO consolidation and Ledger support to Kaspa, lets you delete a FluxNode and free its collateral without a transaction, replaces the node maps with a faster built-in map, and adds InstaSwap as a swap provider.
bugs: Ledger and Hardware Wallets: Since 8.38.0, every Ledger send showed 'Unknown error' while the device was still waiting for your approval, and a Ledger could get stuck on 'Loading device…'. Sends now wait for the device, and the wizard notices an app you open on the device after it started. Swap, Sell, Earn, WalletConnect, Sign Message and other actions a hardware wallet cannot sign are now hidden or refused with a clear message, instead of failing part-way or creating an exchange order first.

Swaps, Payments and Saving: Swap Now and the Fusion deposit now ask for your d2FA PIN before signing, the same as Send, if you have d2FA enabled. Starting a second payment while the 'Transaction Sent!' window was open left an empty send form. It now fills the form. A change made within 10 seconds of an earlier save could be lost, for example when you closed the app right after it. These changes are now saved.

Cardano, Polkadot, Kusama and Beldex: A Cardano token send from a wallet that holds other tokens could be refused by the network, and leftover tokens could be left out. The minimum ADA is now priced at the current network rate, and leftover tokens come back to you as change. Polkadot and Kusama history failed to load with 'Error while obtaining Polkadot transactions'. It loads again. OpenAlias names that point to a Beldex integrated address or subaddress now validate.

Kaspa History: Transactions the network never accepted were shown as successful. They now show as pending or failed. KRC-20 token screens, which always showed an empty history, now list their transfers, and the KAS balance updates right after a KRC-20 send. After switching accounts, the next account no longer sees the previous account's Kasplex indexer warning or KCC token status. On the Igra bridge, an amount equal to your whole KAS balance was accepted and then failed with a generic error. The form now keeps 0.05 KAS back for the fee, the same as the Max button.

Ergo and FluxDrive: In a Flux on Ergo claim, a private key that did not match the Ergo address is now refused at step two instead of failing when the claim is sent. Closing the app during an Ergo token consolidation no longer lets the app offer a second one, which the network rejects. Reopening the FluxDrive plans window after paying could start a new payment and strand the first one. A payment sent in the last 2 hours is now picked up again, and the window waits for it to be credited. A server error after a payment was sent no longer brings the Pay button back, since the first payment may already be on its way.

Earn, Toggles, Dropdowns and Accounts: The Actions column of the Earn positions table now stays visible on narrow screens, so unstake, withdraw and redeem can always be reached. Some switches, such as those in Earn, had a second knob drawn over them. In the night theme, text behind an open dropdown list showed through it. Deleting an account while a full node was running only logged you out, and the account stayed. It is now deleted once the node stops.

Horizen: The ZEN balance and history no longer loaded, because the old ZEN explorers now show the Base network. They load again from Horizen's legacy explorer. Horizen's mainchain stopped at block 1,807,300 when ZEN moved to Base, so sending ZEN from the mainchain wallet is now disabled. ZEN on Base is listed as Horizen BASE Token.
Various UI/UX improvements and stability fixes
Performance optimizations and general bug fixes
features: Solana Token-2022: WINGS, AI16Z, BIO and other tokens on Solana's newer token program show their balance and history, and you can send, receive and merge them.
KRC-20 Tokens: The top KRC-20 tokens are built in with their names. Tokens you list on a marketplace show on the token page and count toward your balance.
dApp Safety Checks: ZelCore checks Cardano and Kaspa dApp requests before you approve them and warns you when it finds a risk.
New Publisher: ZelCore is now published by InFlux Technologies USA LLC. Installed apps keep updating as usual. A newly downloaded Windows installer may show 'Windows protected your PC' for a while.
macOS 13 or Later: ZelCore now runs on Electron 44, which needs macOS 13 or later. Macs on macOS 12 stay on 8.39.
